module.title: MSSQL checker
module.description: Check Microsoft SQL Server: connectivity, databases, backups, agent jobs and custom queries.
module.name: CheckMSSQL

commands.check_mssql: Check SQL Server connectivity and health (version, edition, uptime).
commands.check_mssql_query: Run a custom T-SQL query and apply thresholds to the returned rows.
commands.check_mssql_databases: Check database state, recovery model and data/log size.
commands.check_mssql_backup: Check the age of the last full/differential/log backup per database.
commands.check_mssql_jobs: Check SQL Server Agent job status.
commands.check_mssql_sessions: Check session and connection counts per database and login.
commands.check_mssql_blocking: Check for blocked sessions and blocking chains.
commands.check_mssql_counters: Check engine performance counters: buffer cache, page life expectancy, batch and lock rates.
commands.check_mssql_availability_groups: Check Always On availability group replica and database health.
commands.check_mssql_waits: Check wait statistics by category and scheduler pressure.
commands.check_mssql_tempdb: Check tempdb space usage by consumer and volume headroom.
commands.check_mssql_integrity: Check suspect pages and the age of the last successful DBCC CHECKDB.
commands.check_mssql_transactions: Check for old or leaked open transactions and long-running requests.
